patthana2.13:172.1: Saṃyojanavippayutto dhammo saṃyojanavippayuttassa . . . Dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ uposathakammaṃ taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati. Ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa phalassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā saṃyojanavippayutte pahīnakilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhitakilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilesa jānanti, cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ saṃyojanavippayutte khandhe ca mohañ ca aniccato . . . pe . . . vipassanti.
patthana2.13:272.1: Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyāñāṇena saṃyojanavippayuttacittasamaṃgissa cittaṃ jānāti; ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa . . . pe . . . rūpāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . saṃyojanavippāyuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āmajjanāyā ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. 5. patthana2.13:276.1: garuṃ katvā rāgo, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati:-- saṃyojanasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 2.

patthana2.13:289.1: khandhā ca moho ca pacchimānaṃ . . . 8. Saṃyojanasampayutto

patthana2.13:299.1: Saṃyojanavippayutto dhammo saṃyojanasampayuttassa . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- vatthuṃ saṃyojanasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.13:300.1: Saṃyojanavippayutto dhammo . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ ārabbha uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. Vatthu uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. 2. Saṃyojanasampayutto

Nānākhaṇikā:-- saṃyojanasampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 3. Saṃyojanasampayutto dhammo saṃyojanasampayuttassa ca . . .
